title: The deployer
summary: The deployment manager role's primary interface: standing a packaged agent up, changing it while it runs, and standing it down.

answer_carries: a running agent with an identity, an address and an inbox, or a refusal
its credentials placed by name and its ceilings set before it started
the signed deployment record at the end
each agent stood up: package, version, target, identity, last known state
what was checked, and what kind of check it was
the newer version through the same steps and checks
the same record at the end
the previous version under the same identity, through the same steps and checks
the settings, credentials or ceilings changed on the running agent, with no new version
each change listed, credentials by name only
processes stopped, configuration removed, the identity retired
anything that could not be removed, stated
